data.one_liner: Brings back context.read and context.watch extensions for Riverpod.
data.what_it_does: Brings back context.read and context.watch extensions for Riverpod discontinued in version 1.0.0. Provides convenient context extensions like read, watch, refresh, invalidate, listen, and subscribe to interact with providers.
use_when: You want to use context.read and context.watch style interactions with Riverpod
You want an alternative to ConsumerWidget and ConsumerStatefulWidget
avoid_when: You prefer using official Riverpod ConsumerWidgets without context extensions
You cannot add InheritedConsumer underneath the root ProviderScope
strengths: Familiar context-based API for developers coming from Provider
Supports .select(), provider families, and autoDispose providers
weaknesses: Requires adding InheritedConsumer under the root ProviderScope
Requires caution and rules (like context.prime) when conditionally watching providers
data.setup_notes: Add InheritedConsumer underneath the root ProviderScope.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use the official core package and standard Consumer widgets instead of context extensions.
